messages:
sam: Heads up — planning to start the v2 proxy split tonight at 23:00 UTC. will route 5% to v2 warm path first, then 25% after 15m if metrics look good. @deploybot already has a job queued. anyone needs pinning or tenant holds? :eyes:

mia: +1. can we keep mobile route pinned until we verify streaming behavior? last time mobile hit 422s when headers changed.

sam: yes, mobile routes are pinned by default for the first hour. if anyone wants tenants added to the explicit pinlist say now.

kai: telemetry note — please watch 95th p50 latency, and the token cost delta. set alert if 95th > 200ms OR token cost per request increases by >10% in the canary window.

deploybot: scheduled v2-split job created: `deploybot run v2-split --start 1734568200 --stages 5,25 --rollback-on alarm`

olga: release notes draft: we need to call out header normalization and the session cookie name change. i'll push a short blurb to the release-notes PR now.

mia: adding tenant ids: T-1324, T-9901 to pinlist. also flagging mobile-sdk team to look at streaming tests.

sam: confirm deploybot command looks good. timeline: 23:00 start -> 23:15 check -> 23:30 escalate to 25% if green -> 00:00 full warm. rollback plan is fast rollback to v1 proxy if any critical alarms.

ops-bot: FYI automated rollback criteria: >5% 500s across total traffic for 5m OR canary region error rate spike >200% over baseline for 3m.

kai: can we also enable proto fallback for v2 clients for 30m? means requests with legacy header get mapped to v1 automatically. reduces blast radius.

sam: good idea. enabling header-fallback for 30m. will annotate in the change window.

olga: release notes updated with migration guidance and link to breaking-changes doc. PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pull/482 :white_check_mark:

deploybot: deploy started at 1734568200. canary stage 5% live. logs: `deploybot tail v2-split/1734568200` for more.

mia: spotting a small spike in mobile 422s at t+2m. digging in with mobile-sdk.

sam: keep updates here. if mobile teams want an immediate pin override say so.

mobile-sdk: (via DM) confirming header quirk reproduced, pushing hotfix to client this morning.

mia: rollback? current error spike is isolated to mobile UA, overall traffic ok but mobile 422s ~3.2% now.

sam: hold on rollback. switch mobile tenant pins to 100% v1 for affected tenants T-1324 only. Mia can you enact?

mia: done — pin applied to T-1324. mobile 422s drop to 0.5% after pin.

kai: 15m canary window complete. p50 latency stable, token cost +2%, error rate within thresholds. recommend proceed to 25%.

deploybot: advancing to 25% at 1734568450.

sam: thanks all. keeping header-fallback and mobile pins for first hour. final check at 00:00 then full warm. I'll post final go/no-go then. :thumbsup:
